name: io.github.sgInnora/noracu
description: Local MCP server: macOS apps and a browser by element index, plus iPhone Mirroring (experimental).

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for observation only: the tools that read stay, every input tool is refused.

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_LAYERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated layers whose tools are listed: mac, browser, iphone. The experimental iPhone layer is on only when named.

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_STOP_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file: while it exists, no input is sent.

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_APPROVAL_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a 0600 JSON file {allow, ask, deny} of bundle ids or app names that may receive input.

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_DENY_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated bundle ids or app names that never receive input; added to the default list (terminals and IDEs with a terminal).

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_USER_IDLE_S
environmentVariables.description: Seconds without the person's keyboard or mouse input before Mac or iPhone Mirroring input is sent; 0 turns the wait off.

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_ENABLE_EVAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to turn browser_evaluate on. It is off by default because it runs any script in the page.

environmentVariables.name: NORACU_ALLOW_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let browser_launch with chrome:true work in your own Chrome instead of a separate profile.
